headline: Anthropic reports roughly $17 billion in third quarter revenue in amended S-1
body: Anthropic reported updated financials in an amended Form S-1 filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday: roughly $17 billion in revenue in its third quarter. In the filing, Anthropic said its aggregate committed spend on purchase commitments and lease agreements is about $895.4 billion, "substantially all of which is related to compute and infrastructure." CNBC reports that third quarter revenue increased around 47%, down from 144% growth in Q2 and 132% in Q1.
note: Growth slowed quarter to quarter while compute commitments grew large, a pairing lenders to AI infrastructure will read closely.

evidence.text: Anthropic reported updated financials as part of an amended Form S-1 filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, giving investors a more comprehensive look into the state of its business.
During its third quarter, Anthropic generated roughly $17 billion in revenue, up about 1,127% from the same period last year.
Revenue growth slowed on a quarter-to-quarter basis, however. Third-quarter revenue increased around 47%, a steep drop from 144% growth in Q2 and 132% in Q1.

In the amended S-1, Anthropic said it has entered into purchase commitments and lease agreements with an aggregate committed spend of about $895.4 billion, "substantially all of which is related to compute and infrastructure."
